description: Scope that compresses the past towards the left: the newest sample is drawn at the right edge, and each pixel further left covers a longer span of time than the one before

params.text: Alt mode: takes a sample every sample rather than a thousand times a second, at a heavy cost in CPU

inputs.text: The voltage drawn on the scope; the display spans -10V at the bottom to +10V at the top

notes: nothing is drawn until a cable is patched here; with the jack empty the trace stops advancing and holds what it last captured.
the trace holds 8192 samples, which at the default rate is a little over 8 seconds of history.
